ordering: runtime freeze < evaluator freeze < holdout data generation < HOLDOUT_FROZEN
frozen_semantics: citation metric numerators: resolvability/validity/precision over answered rows; coverage and supported-claim rate over claim verdict counts

abstention/conflict scoring over the conflict-abstention suite
source diversity: required-multi-source pass rate over multihop + crossdomain rows
case inclusion: every row of every frozen suite is scored; no row may be dropped or added after freeze
rule: After this file exists NO evaluator semantics may change.
